mixless 0.1.0 is the first stable release for macOS, with two-deck mixing, stem controls, AutoMix, and MIDI/HID controller support.

## Changes since beta.4

- Keep AutoMix transition planning on separate workers from background Best order searches, so a busy search cannot occupy every worker needed for the next handoff. Improve queue changes, playback clocks, and manual control during transitions.
- Improve phrase, vocal, rhythm, and sounding-key checks across consecutive transitions. Plan stem exchanges and tempo/pitch recovery using the state carried from the preceding mix, while respecting manual IN/OUT cues.
- Reuse completed planning work and measured audio evidence to reduce repeated Best order and transition calculations. Preserve distinct transition routes when their source endpoints match.
- Separate vocals, drums, bass, and other instruments with one BS-RoFormer model. Reuse stems after metadata-only edits and bound parallel inference by available resources.
- Process downloaded audio inside the app with pinned, statically linked FFmpeg audio libraries. Preserve recording metadata and choose download filenames. Website search and downloading still use yt-dlp and optional Deno.
- Add independent MIDI/HID presets, community adapters, and direct mapping controls. Improve library recovery, cache handling, and macOS compatibility across Apple Silicon and Intel.

## Install or update

Requires macOS 12 or later. Both installers contain the same universal app and use the same library. Stem and note inference requires Apple Silicon; Intel Macs can play existing cached stems.

Download the standard installer or the installer with models from [the website](https://mixless.alkinum.com/#downloads). Open the DMG and drag mixless to Applications, or double-click the app to install. Existing beta installations stay on the beta update channel; install 0.1.0 manually to move to stable. Development builds do not install public updates.

The app and installers are Developer ID signed, Apple notarized, and stapled. `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers both installers; `mixless-stable-latest.json` supplies the stable update feed. Each app includes FFmpeg notices, corresponding source, and rebuild instructions.

## Notes

Analysis and AutoMix choices remain estimates; audition unfamiliar transitions. Automated checks do not establish listening quality or glitch-free playback under every workload.

Spotify supplies playlist metadata. Playable audio must be available locally or through a download service, and imported audio remains subject to its own rights.
